title: Mild synthesis of fused polycyclic 1,6-naphthyridin-4-amines and their optical properties
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,27551-27557
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03301B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ze Li, Dongfeng Zhang, Hanxun Wang, Haihong Huang, Maosheng Cheng, Hongyi Zhao
We have successfully developed a straightforward route to tri-, tetra-, and pentacyclic 1,6-naphthyridin-4-amines through intramolecular cyclisation of 4-(arylamino)nicotinonitriles, and their fluorescent properties were studied.
